conceptZh: 溫馨木框窗戶簡化轉化為方形文字「口」
object: A handcrafted oak wooden square window frame
morph: The wooden window frame flattens and transforms into four saturated dark-navy strokes forming the character 口
creativeAngle: 跳脫傳統大張嘴巴的意象，採用兒童熟悉的方形窗戶切入。結合小鳥啼鳴的趣味小驚喜，將實體窗框流暢轉化為標準「口」字，兼具開口語意與高度幾何辨識度。
promptEn: An 8-second educational animation for young Taiwanese children teaching the Traditional Chinese character 口. On a soft warm-cream background, a handcrafted oak square window frame sits perfectly centered. During 0 to 2 seconds, a small cartoon bird peeks through the square opening, chirps merrily, and flies off. Between 2 and 5 seconds, the wooden frame's texture melts into a bold, solid dark-navy color, reshaping into the exact four strokes of the Traditional Chinese character 口, perfectly proportioned to occupy 70% of the frame height with balanced margins. From 5 to 8 seconds, the character holds entirely still for a full 3-second final freeze. Clear Taiwanese Mandarin voiceover repeats the pronunciation 'ㄎㄡˇ' (kǒu) four times during the hold. Bright, high-contrast, child-friendly visual styling without neon glare, flashing, text overlays, or watermarks.

conceptZh: 滑稽的機械玩具怪獸張大嘴巴卡成方形，轉化為標準的「口」字
object: A comical mechanical toy monster with an oversized glossy mouth
morph: The toy monster's mouth stretches wide around a toy block and snaps into a square frame, which thickens into the four navy-blue strokes of 口
creativeAngle: 回應「搞笑的口腔」需求，以機械玩具怪獸張大嘴巴咬方塊時意外卡成正方形的喜劇喜感作為視覺隱喻，流暢過渡至標準「口」字，並符合最後3秒靜止留白與「口、口、口袋」的臺灣國語語音規範。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D stylized animation on a soft light cream background featuring a comical mechanical toy monster with a big glossy mouth. From 0 to 2 seconds, the toy monster opens its oversized rounded mouth wide to take a giant bite of a floating toy block, but its mouth unexpectedly pops into a rigid, perfectly symmetrical square frame in a funny cartoon shock. From 2 to 5 seconds, the monster's body gently dissolves away as its square mouth thickens and snaps cleanly into the four bold navy-blue strokes of the single Traditional Chinese character 口, centered, uncropped, and filling 70% of the frame height with balanced margins. From 5 to 8 seconds, the scene comes to a complete static freeze on the dark navy glyph 口 for a full 3-second final hold. A warm, friendly off-screen voiceover speaks clearly in Taiwanese Mandarin: '口、口、口袋'. The composition remains bright, clean, and minimal with soft studio lighting, containing no subtitles, no additional text, no watermarks, and no background noise louder than the narration.

conceptZh: 自信滿滿的河馬廚師想把麵團拋進嘴裡，卻讓麵團穿過「口」字的空心，啪地落在高帽上。
object: One soft dough ball and an original rotund cartoon hippo chef wearing a tall chef hat
morph: Begin with the completed glyph. Its empty interior frames the dough's flight, while the chef's actual mouth demonstrates the meaning; the glyph never deforms.
creativeAngle: 不再把嘴巴或窗框變成字，而讓正確的三筆「口」字全程擔任舞台中心。廚師拋接失準，麵團把高帽壓成扁帽；最後用小小一拋成功接入口中，以具體動作連結字義。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animation with a fixed frontal camera, warm cream background, and bright, soft lighting. Display one correctly formed Traditional Chinese glyph 口 in saturated dark coral, centered and uncropped, approximately 70% of frame height with generous margins. Use a standard bold three-stroke form: left vertical, connected top-and-right turning stroke, and bottom horizontal, with a clean empty interior. Keep its shape and position stable throughout. An original rotund cartoon hippo chef with a tall squashable hat stands beneath the opening, rendered smaller than the glyph. The chef is extravagantly confident, with raised eyebrows and a proud belly-forward stance. One soft dough ball is the only prop. During the first 0.7 seconds, the chef opens its mouth and confidently aims the dough toward it. From 0.7 to 2.1 seconds, an excessive flick sends the dough soaring through the glyph's empty opening; the chef follows it with wide eyes and an eagerly open mouth. After a brief anticipation pause, the dough drops onto the tall hat instead, flattening the hat into a ridiculous pancake silhouette with a gentle 'pof.' Let the chef blink once at the failed catch. From 2.1 to 4.4 seconds, the chef lifts the dough off the flattened hat, gives it a tiny, careful toss directly into its mouth, and smiles proudly before waddling out below the frame. Keep the glyph visually dominant and its strokes unobstructed throughout the action. From 4.4 seconds through exactly 8.0 seconds, hold only the finished glyph completely still, with its interior empty and its edges crisp. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly '口、口、口水': the first 口 around 0.3–0.8 seconds, the second around 3.3–3.8 seconds, and 口水 around 5.2–6.2 seconds. Preserve natural pauses and stop after the word. The vocabulary is audio only; display only the single target glyph, without subtitles or other text. Use quiet dough and hat sound effects beneath the voice, no music, no flashing effects, no watermark, and no logos. All visual elements are original stylized animation.
